markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Zero invasive risk (0%), foundation-model agreement, and 5/5 Normal neighbors support routine Tier 4 review.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 98%, InSitu 1%, Benign 0%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Strong separation; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal} (10% alpha; 90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Passes QC; no reliability flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (84%–86% similarity) [F5] | All nearest neighbors match Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 8, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.988 contribution), 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 8, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.587 contribution), 20/20 AI spot check [F3] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (+0.349 contribution), 12/20 AI spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 5, 6, 7) · ↑ invasive · Elevated (+0.287 contribution), 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **HoVer-Net nuclei segmentation** (regions 5, 6, 7) · context · 62% tumor fraction [F7], 93rd-percentile size variation [F8] (15/21 spot check) · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 spans 0); leans on Unreliable `normal_lobules` (0/20) and `mitoses` (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal lesion in regions 5, 6, 7, where HoVer-Net counted 56–65 neoplastic nuclei per region.
- Missed InSitu lesion like contrast case `BACH_0012` (82% similarity), differing in `duct_confined` and Unreliable `necrosis` (3/20).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 5**: Inspect highest-risk tile (17% risk) with 56 neoplastic-labeled nuclei and elevated pleomorphism (18/20 spot check).
2. **Regions 6, 7**: Verify whether 65 and 64 neoplastic-labeled nuclei are benign epithelium, lymphocytes, or atypia.
3. **Regions 8, 10, 11**: Confirm benign stroma and normal lobules visually; `normal_lobules` is Unreliable (0/20).
